name: Two-tailed Swallowtail
desc: Two-tailed Swallowtail (Papilio multicaudata): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 9 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Papilio multicaudata, the two-tailed swallowtail, is a species of the family Papilionidae found in western North America from British Columbia to Central America.
